input.quote: Each Service Option Attachment will renew automatically for an additional term equal in duration to the previous term of the applicable Service Option Attachment unless either party notifies the other party in writing at least ninety (90) days prior to the end of the then-current term for the applicable Service Option Attachment that it has elected to terminate such Service Option Attachment.
input.rationale: § 3.2 auto-renews each Service Option Attachment for a term equal in duration to the prior term with a 90-day non-renewal notice window. The window exceeds the fallback ceiling of 60 days, and because renewal length simply mirrors the previous term, any multi-year initial term (§ 3.1 leaves term length to the Order Form) produces automatic multi-year renewals — walk-away territory. There is also no renewal price mechanic anywhere (§ 4.1 Charges is silent), so uplift is uncapped. Our redline moves to the preferred position: 30-day Customer opt-out, fixed 12-month renewals, a 60-day IBM reminder, and uplift capped at the lesser of CPI and 3%; a 60-day window with a 5% cap is the fallback we can accept.

proposal.summary: Shorten non-renewal notice to 30 days, fix renewal term at 12 months, add renewal reminder and cap renewal price increases
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We shortened the non-renewal notice window from 90 days to 30 days, fixed each renewal at twelve months rather than the prior term's length, and capped renewal price increases, consistent with our playbook position that renewals be easy to exit and predictably priced. If helpful, we can live with a 60-day window and a 5% cap as a fallback.

ops.oldText: Each Service Option Attachment will renew automatically for an additional term equal in duration to the previous term of the applicable Service Option Attachment unless either party notifies the other party in writing at least ninety (90) days prior to the end of the then-current term for the applicable Service Option Attachment that it has elected to terminate such Service Option Attachment.
ops.newText: Each Service Option Attachment will renew automatically for an additional term of twelve (12) months unless either party notifies the other party in writing at least thirty (30) (in the case of Customer) or ninety (90) (in the case of IBM) days prior to the end of the then-current term for the applicable Service Option Attachment that it has elected to terminate such Service Option Attachment. IBM will notify Customer in writing of the upcoming renewal at least sixty (60) days prior to the end of the then-current term. Charges for any renewal term will not increase by more than the lesser of (i) the increase in the U.S. Consumer Price Index over the preceding twelve (12) months and (ii) three percent (3%) of the Charges in effect during the then-current term.
